CommunityApplications.Profile: DockTail for Unraid — expose Docker containers as native Tailscale Services from docktail.* container labels, without giving each app its own Tailscale device. This repository maintains the DockTail plugin; DockTail itself is developed by marvinvr (https://github.com/marvinvr/docktail). Support and bug reports: https://github.com/vcolombo/docktail-unraid/issues
